summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting that Provident Financial Services, Inc. completed a public offering of $175 million of 6.50% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036 under an existing S-3ASR shelf. Issued August 24, 2026, the notes are subordinated unsecured obligations. Net proceeds will repay $150 million of 2.875% notes due 2031 and $20 million of variable-rate junior subordinated notes due 2033, with remainder for general corporate purposes. Piper Sandler and Keefe, Bruyette & Woods led the underwriting. This is a routine debt issuance and refinancing, not a special situation.
